description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is a global security and aerospace company developing advanced technology systems, products, and services. The LRASM Embedded Software Engineer will develop and maintain embedded and desktop software, including designing, coding, testing, and integrating software for embedded multi-core systems and sensor and countermeasure emulation applications.
Embedded software engineer for defense sensor and countermeasure systems, developing and integrating C/C++ applications

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain embedded software applications and/or desktop applications
• Tasks will involve requirement, design, code, test, and integrate software for an embedded multi-core system as well as desktop computer applications for emulation of sensors and countermeasures
• The successful candidate will have training in C/C++, prior experience in GUI development, experience with Linux OS

Requirements:
• • BS or MS degree from accredited university in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Math, or related major
• • Experience with C++ and Object-oriented design
• • Experience with software development on Linux or similar preemptive operating systems
• • Ability to obtain an interim secret security clearance prior to start

Preferred:
• • Experience with use of software configuration management systems e.g., Git, GitHub, GitLab, SVN
• • Familiarity with Modular Open Systems Architecture (MOSA) design concepts
• • Familiarity with containerized development and deployment environments
• • Familiarity with Data distribution service (DDS)
• • Familiarity with Yocto OS development
